test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Admittance was refused to him by the airport security.

options.text: The airport security is refusing him admittance.
The airport security has refused him admittance.
The airport security had refused him admittance .
The airport security refused him admittance.

solution:
The correct answer is **The airport security refused him admittance**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Simple Past **tense.
 
• The structure of active and passive forms in Simple Past tense is as follows:
 
 
• **Active:** Subject + V2 + Object
 
• **Passive**: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• **Active**: Our teacher taught this chapter in the last class.
 
• **Passive**: This chapter was taught by our teacher in the last class. 
 
 

Hence, the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice is **The airport security refused him admittance.**
